reason: The README clearly describes a DSH plugin for authoring, visually editing, compiling, and exporting PPT/PPTX presentations, with local filesystem and process capabilities documented.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DSH 中生成、可视化编辑并导出 PPTX 演示文稿的演示文稿创作插件。
summaries.en: A DSH plugin for generating, visually editing, compiling, and exporting PPTX presentations.

capabilities: Generates presentation content through a DSH agent preset
Runs a local web-based visual editor on port 55173
Reads and writes user-authorized local presentation directories
Executes a Python compiler to produce PPTX files
May install Python dependencies with pip on first compilation
